announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v3.1.0
announcement.content:
v3.1.0 adds a standalone OBS HUD and improves broadcast setup.

  • Export the party or individual actors as HTML files for local Browser Sources in OBS 28 or later. OBS loads only the HUD, with live values, portraits, conditions, and themes. Badge placement and fonts match the in-game HUD, including damage and healing feedback and voice indicators. Keep the GM's Foundry window open and connect it to OBS WebSocket; no Foundry login is needed inside OBS.
  • Remember the OBS address and password in the current browser to reconnect after Foundry reloads or reopens. HUD updates pause while the source is absent from both the OBS program and preview, then resume with the latest state when shown. Foundry scene changes do not pause the HUD. Stop sending pauses automatic connection, and clearing the remember option deletes the saved password.
  • Broadcast Settings separates the standalone HTML setup from the Foundry URL overlay, with connection status, diagnostic copying, and manual source selection for renamed files. The URL overlay can skip map loading and fixes Foundry V13 and V14 login and link handling. Fixed-actor links retain their actor after refreshes; invalid links and rendering failures show an explanation instead of a blank screen. Both modes remain visible when the regular HUD is hidden.
  • Glass portraits retain the theme's default scale when no actor or global scale has been set.
